Une action de solidarité pour la rentrée: A solidarity action for the back-to-school season of orphaned children
À la veille de la rentrée des classes po: On the eve of the start of the 2026-2027 school year, Ooredoo Algérie carried out a civic initiative on Thursday, September 10, 2026, in Bentalha. The operation was conducted in collaboration with the National Foundation for Health Promotion and Research Development (FOREM).
Cet événement a enregistré la présence d: This event was attended by the president of FOREM, Professor Mustapha Khiati, as well as the director of institutional affairs, media relations, and corporate social responsibility of Ooredoo Algérie, Mr. Ramdane Djezairi. This initiative aims to provide better conditions for orphaned children and those from low-income families to promote equal opportunities and support their social integration.
Dans le cadre de ce partenariat, l'opéra: As part of this partnership, the operator provided a financial contribution intended for the purchase of schoolbags and school supplies. These items benefited children cared for within the psychological centers of Bentalha and Zemouri.
